item.title: Israel Says It Killed a Hezbollah Chief Near Beirut, Testing the Truce
item.description: The strike was the first near the Lebanese capital since a cease-fire that has curbed fighting but not halted it. Washington is pushing for a lasting peace, hoping it will ease diplomacy with Iran.

item.title: As Stockpiles Fall, U.S. Sells More Missiles Worth $17 Billion to Gulf Nations
item.description: The United States and its partners have burned through an enormous amount of air defense missiles in the Iran war, and production is slow.

item.title: Live Updates: Early U.K. Election Results Point to Big Losses for Starmer’s Party
item.description: Votes are still being tallied in thousands of local races across Britain, but hundreds of candidates from Prime Minister Keir Starmer’s Labour Party have already lost their council seats.

item.title: German Leaders Clash With Spy Chiefs Over Domestic Threat From Iran
item.description: Intelligence agents have privately warned of the potential of hybrid attacks from Iran-linked groups. But political leaders, including Chancellor Friedrich Merz, have publicly played down the risk.

item.title: A Project in Europe Tested Whether Students Could Live Without Smartphones
item.description: For three weeks, thousands of children in Europe went without social media or their smartphones, or both. This is the diary of their digital detox.

item.title: U.S. and Iran Trade Strikes as Tensions in Strait of Hormuz Rise
item.description: The escalating attacks raise the threat that the cease-fire could break down.

item.title: Starmer Braces for Local Election Losses Amid New Era of UK Politics
item.description: Polls predict historic losses for Prime Minister Keir Starmer’s Labour Party on Thursday as anti-immigrant Reform U.K. makes gains, and a new era of multiparty politics takes shape.

item.title: Russia Ramps Up Threats Toward Ukraine Over Victory Day Parade
item.description: Kremlin officials said a large strike on Kyiv would be “inevitable” if Ukraine disrupted the May 9 event, a prospect President Volodymyr Zelensky has appeared to allude to.
